name: Abu Dhabi

population.source: Statistics Centre - Abu Dhabi (SCAD), Abu Dhabi Census: population by region and sex, 2024 (integrated administrative registers)
population.note: The Abu Dhabi Census's 2024 count from the emirate's integrated administrative registers: 2,767,060 men and 1,368,925 women, in the regions of Abu Dhabi (2,823,340), Al Ain (986,910) and Al Dhafra (325,735). The revised 2023 census (R1) counted 3,847,585.

median_age.note: SCAD's census site (census.scad.gov.ae) publishes the emirate's population by sex and region only: no age groups, so no median age can be taken.

sex_ratio.source: Statistics Centre - Abu Dhabi (SCAD), Abu Dhabi Census: population by region and sex, 2024 (integrated administrative registers)

religion.note: SCAD's census site (census.scad.gov.ae) publishes the emirate's population by sex and region only: no religion.

language.note: SCAD's census site (census.scad.gov.ae) publishes the emirate's population by sex and region only: no language.

ethnicity.note: SCAD's census site (census.scad.gov.ae) publishes the emirate's population by sex and region only: no nationality (citizens or not), so no nationality split is published for the emirate.

sources.name: Statistics Centre - Abu Dhabi (SCAD), Abu Dhabi Census: population by region and sex, 2024 (integrated administrative registers)
